snippet.title: Stuck in the Present || Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
In Stuck in the Present, you play as Faye: a young Filipina immigrant stuck in a twisted subway station under an unfamiliar city. To escape, you must face the haunting memories of a buried past you so desperately left behind. There's no escaping the truth this time.

📅Coming to Steam on September 19, 2025.
🎮Play the demo and wishlist now!
🔗 https://tinyurl.com/SiTPWishlist
